stages.purpose: Bind the source image, hashes, provenance, and target avatar.
Separate pose and viewpoint effects from garment evidence.
Name garment parts by construction role and body region.
Create explicit two-dimensional panel boundaries and correspondence identifiers.
Create explicit edge-to-edge and multi-edge sewing topology.
Place pattern pieces around the avatar without folds or intersections.
Invoke the declared Blender Python build script through one reusable adapter.
Apply the declared cloth, collision, and cache contract.
Bind semantic body regions to bones and export the editable source and FBX.
Render required five views and declared poses from the current artifact.
Measure topology, weights, degeneracy, collisions, and evidence hashes.
Require direct inspection of current images before visualAppearanceReview can pass.
Write the truthful WORKING, COMPLETE, or REJECTED candidate state.
